label: Frontend Layer
ownerQuestion: Can the owner and operators understand and use the product without reading code?
evidence: No Next.js/TS/build frontend was found in this repo; repo frontend-glob scan only matched ops-watcher/cockpit-snapshot.html. The real owner-facing surface is Telegram: docs/standards/design-quality-standard.md:30, ops-watcher/telegram-notify.mjs:12-15, ops-watcher/telegram-notify.mjs:95-98, ops-watcher/telegram-listener.mjs:20-55.

label: API And Backend Logic
ownerQuestion: Are workflows exposed through typed APIs and server-side business logic?
evidence: Backend orchestration exists as Node .mjs workers around Paperclip and Telegram, not as a typed app API: ops-watcher/heartbeat.mjs:9-23, ops-watcher/directive-runner.mjs:2-18, ops-watcher/ahmad-dispatch.mjs:496-535.

label: Database And Storage
ownerQuestion: Is durable state separated from file artifacts?
evidence: Operational state is separated across Paperclip/local database identity, config JSON, and append-only/log state files: config/paperclip-endpoint.json:3-28, config/agent-registry.json:97, knowledge/p4-research/technical-integration-sketch.md:7-10, ops-watcher/watcher.mjs:27-28, ops-watcher/heartbeat.mjs:174, ops-watcher/lane-usage.mjs:28-31.

label: Authentication And Authorization
ownerQuestion: Who may access the system, and what are they allowed to do?
evidence: Telegram owner gating and role authority exist, but no web login/Mini App auth is implemented yet: ops-watcher/telegram-client.mjs:44, ops-watcher/telegram-listener.mjs:448-452, hatta/harness.mjs:205-237, config/agent-registry.json:272, knowledge/ahmad-mini-app/AHMAD-TELEGRAM-MINI-APP-SCOPE-2026-08-30.md:11-17.

label: Hosting And Deployment
ownerQuestion: How does the app run, restart, and get promoted?
evidence: Local PM2 hosting/supervision exists, but production/cloud promotion is deferred: ops-watcher/ecosystem.config.cjs:73-75, ops-watcher/ecosystem.config.cjs:146-220, ops-watcher/pm2-supervisor.mjs:1-18, scripts/pm2-supervisor-run.cmd:4, handoffs/ahmad/NEXT-SESSION-PROMPT-2026-08-31.md:17.

label: Cloud Compute
ownerQuestion: Which work runs locally, and which bounded work may use free or already-paid cloud capacity?
evidence: Lane routing knows local/cloud/free lanes and cooldowns, but the zero-laptop/cloud migration is not implemented: ops-watcher/routing.mjs:2-18, ops-watcher/routing.mjs:39-64, config/agent-registry.json:143, config/agent-registry.json:706-708.

label: CI/CD And Version Control
ownerQuestion: Can changes be reviewed, verified, and rolled forward predictably?
evidence: Local regression and promotion gates exist, but no .github CI directory was found: docs/standards/self-evolution-governance.md:28, docs/standards/self-evolution-governance.md:39, ops-watcher/run-all-tests.mjs:1-5, ops-watcher/run-all-tests.mjs:134-146, ops-watcher/run-all-tests.mjs:247-250.

label: Role-Level Security
ownerQuestion: Does every AI role have explicit authority, scope, and mutation limits?
evidence: HATTA has lexical/realpath workspace jail, command policy, secret/package mutation guards, and registry-defined role authority: hatta/harness.mjs:12, hatta/harness.mjs:200-237, hatta/harness.mjs:255-268, hatta/harness.mjs:420-433, hatta/harness.security.test.mjs:139-152, config/agent-registry.json:259-272, config/agent-registry.json:286.

label: Rate Limiting
ownerQuestion: Can the system stop costly or runaway calls before quota burns?
evidence: Lane-level quota/cooldown guards exist, including long quota cooldown and skip reasons, but no general HTTP edge rate limit layer is present: ops-watcher/lane-guard.mjs:52-92, ops-watcher/routing.mjs:45-64, ops-watcher/routing.mjs:227-310, ops-watcher/routing.regression.test.mjs:580-614.

label: Cache And CDN
ownerQuestion: What is cached, and what must always be live/honest?
evidence: Deferred because this repo has no deployed frontend/CDN path; the richer Telegram Mini App requires HTTPS always-on cloud hosting and is explicitly held until P6 opens: knowledge/ahmad-mini-app/AHMAD-TELEGRAM-MINI-APP-SCOPE-2026-08-30.md:15-19, knowledge/ahmad-mini-app/AHMAD-TELEGRAM-MINI-APP-SCOPE-2026-08-30.md:55-68, handoffs/ahmad/NEXT-SESSION-PROMPT-2026-08-31.md:17.

label: Load Balancer And Scaling
ownerQuestion: How does the system handle more users, agents, or machines?
evidence: Deferred because current scaling is local PM2 supervision plus lane routing/queue discipline, while multi-host/cloud scaling remains P6/future work: ops-watcher/pm2-supervisor.mjs:60, ops-watcher/routing.mjs:324-357, config/agent-registry.json:662, config/agent-registry.json:706-708.

label: Error And Tracking
ownerQuestion: Can failures be diagnosed from durable evidence instead of vibes?
evidence: Durable tracking is real: ops-watcher/heartbeat-steps.jsonl and ops-watcher/lane-usage.jsonl are present and populated. Writers and failure handling are defined in ops-watcher/heartbeat.mjs:122-124, ops-watcher/heartbeat.mjs:300-303, ops-watcher/lane-usage.mjs:9-18, ops-watcher/lane-usage.mjs:34-58, ops-watcher/telegram-listener.mjs:76-112, ops-watcher/telegram.regression.test.mjs:767-909.

label: Availability And Recovery
ownerQuestion: What happens when a model, machine, DB, or owner approval is unavailable?
evidence: Availability/recovery mechanisms exist in PM2 supervision, heartbeat step logging, bounded self-repair, and actuator snapshots, but cloud/zero-laptop recovery remains deferred: ops-watcher/pm2-supervisor.mjs:1-18, ops-watcher/pm2-supervisor.mjs:506-610, ops-watcher/self-repair.mjs:4-23, ops-watcher/self-repair.mjs:44-46, ops-watcher/self-repair-actuator.mjs:43-55, ops-watcher/self-repair-actuator.mjs:378-427, config/agent-registry.json:706-708.
